title: Needs and wants
summary: Needs are things we must have to live and learn; wants make life nicer but can wait.

variants.markdown:
**English draft for R5 review.**

A **need** is something you must have to stay safe, healthy and able to learn: food, a roof, school books, the bus fare to school. A **want** makes life nicer, but you can manage without it for now: a new phone cover, a second pair of shoes, snacks after class.

The same thing can move between the two. A phone can be a need for a parent who gets work calls, and a want when it's the newest model. Pay for needs first, then decide which wants are worth it. Gullak uses virtual play money only.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a need?

options.text: The monthly bus pass to get to school
A cricket jersey of your favourite team

questions.explanation: Getting to school is something you can't skip; the game and the jersey can wait.

questions.prompt: Ravi's family has ₹500 left for the week. Which is a want?
questions.explanation: Pizza is nice but optional. Food and medicine come first.

questions.prompt: When is a smartphone more likely to be a need?

options.text: When a parent needs it to get work calls
When a newer model comes out

questions.explanation: The same item can be a need or a want depending on what it's for.
